limitations: Six new physical branches checked against all IDs and addresses in research/dtla.json, west.json, north.json and central.json (100 existing records). Regional coverage: Santa Ana two, Brea one, Newport Beach one, south Laguna Beach one, San Juan Capistrano one. No Fullerton branch retained; Brea supplies the requested northern OC focus.

All reviews use agent-source-inspection, not human inspection or restaurant confirmation. Official public pages were opened individually through web/browser tools; no bulk scraper, access-control bypass, paid API or subscription used. No raw pages, menu prose or media saved.
Coordinates intentionally null for parent government-geocoding; Orange County jurisdiction and coordinates are not independently government-verified in this file.

Five records have a directly supported food/drink price pair. Benchmark intentionally has an empty menu because inspected current official happy-hour text lacks numeric prices. No final prices calculated from discounts.

Regular weekly windows can be overridden by holidays, closures, private events and menu changes. Unknown exceptions are not represented as affirmative availability. Item amounts exclude taxes, tips and disclosed extra fees.

Policy discovery is bounded to inspected public links and focused searches. Missing policies or no identified prohibition is not an affirmative license. Mayfield's TERMS/PRIVACY links point back to its menu; substantive policies remain unresolved. Hosting-provider terms were not comprehensively established.
Starfish excluded because its official terms restrict harvesting and redistribution. Wood Ranch and Lazy Dog were not used or inspected, as instructed.
